subject: BlueWave procurement launch & demo — coordination and required steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lynn Carter <lynn.carter@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueWave procurement launch & demo — coordination and required steps

Hi Lynn — great to meet last week. Following up to get a short multi-stakeholder session on the calendar to align procurement, security, and the eng/dev teams and to run a focused demo for your SEs. Proposed goals: 

- 30–45 minute walkthrough of Redwood inference for procurement checklist (data flows, retention, audit logs)
- SE-led demo of typical integration (API + embeddings + RDW routing)
- Agree on procurement artifacts and timeline (SOC2, SOW, support/SLA expectations)

Suggested time windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-10-05: 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed 2026-10-06: 09:30–10:15 or 15:00–15:45

Attendees we plan to include: 
- Aditya Rao (AE, Redwood) — program lead
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer, Redwood) — demo lead
- Nikhil Sharma (Security/Compliance, Redwood) — SOC2 + logs
- Your procurement lead + security rep + 1–2 engineers (SE/FE)

If you can share the right procurement/security contacts and the best times from the windows above, I’ll lock in a calendar invite and circulate a brief agenda + pre-read. I’m attaching a placeholder calendar_availability.ics and a rough SOW outline.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: calendar_availability.ics (availability grid), BlueWave_SOW_v0.2.pdf (draft)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueWave procurement launch & demo — coordination and required steps

Thanks — quick internal sync:

Agreed items before the session:
- I will lead the live demo and cover embedding/indexing flow (10–15m).
- Nikhil, can you prepare a 5–7 slide summary of SOC2 scope + what we can share (we should not send full reports, but a cert snippet is fine).
- Karthik: please confirm if we want to propose a two-week pilot pricing or present standard list ahead of procurement.

Suggested core agenda (to be trimmed once BlueWave confirms):
1) 10m – Intros & procurement checklist (Aditya + procurement contact)
2) 15m – Live integration demo (Marissa)
3) 10m – Security/Q&A (Nikhil + security contact)
4) 5–10m – Next steps & timeline (Aditya)

If their window is 10/5 morning, I can do 10:00–10:45. If they prefer 10/6 afternoon, I’m also available at 15:00.

On attachments: I attached the SOW draft we use as a starting point; we should redline for any BlueWave-specific language after the call.

— Marissa
From: Lynn Carter <lynn.carter@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@bluewavehealth.com>, Procure Ops <procure@bluewavehealth.com>, security.team@bluewavehealth.com
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2026 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueWave procurement launch & demo — coordination and required steps

Hi Aditya — thanks for circling back. Rajiv (cc’d) will be our procurement lead; I’m looping security.team for scope. A few quick answers and asks: 

Availability: we prefer Tue 10/5 at 10:00 PT. That time works for Rajiv and two of our backend engineers.

Pre-reads/artifacts we need before the call:
- SOC2 attestation or excerpt (we can accept a redacted snippet)
- Short data retention and deletion policy (one pager)
- Draft SOW (we’ll have legal look at it)

Security question: do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for private deployments? Our security team will ask this in the call.

If you can confirm the invite and include a brief agenda + the three artifacts above, we’ll make time for a 45-minute session.

Thanks,
Lynn Carter
Director, IT Procurement | BlueWave Health
lynn.carter@bluewavehealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0184

Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: BlueWave procurement launch — Tue 5 Oct 2026, 10:00–10:45 PT (45m)

Thanks Lynn & Rajiv — confirmed and invite sent. Quick summary and attachments: 

When: Tue, 5 Oct 2026 | 10:00–10:45 PT (45m) — calendar invite attached.
Where: Zoom (link in calendar invite)
Attendees (confirmed):
- BlueWave: Lynn Carter (Procurement), Rajiv Menon (Procurement lead), 2x backend engineers, security.team rep (TBD)
- Redwood: Aditya Rao (AE), Marissa Cole (SE, demo lead), Nikhil Sharma (Security/Compliance), Karthik Iyer (Pricing), Lauren Bishop (Customer Success)

Pre-reads attached: BlueWave_SOW_v0.2.pdf (draft), SOC2_cert_snippet.pdf (redacted) — we will also bring a one-pager on retention/deletion to the call.

Key asks for the meeting:
- Security: confirm KMS/HSM support and any additional controls you need for private deployments.
- Procurement: confirm target contract timeline (we suggested 4–6 weeks for review + signatures).
- Eng: identify a technical follow-up owner for any integration PoC.

Next steps after the call: 1) Redlines on SOW, 2) Security follow-up doc, 3) Pilot/pricing proposal. I’ll log all notes to HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/654321 and share a short meeting summary within 24 hours.

Looking forward — see you Tuesday.

Best,
Aditya

Attachments: BlueWave_SOW_v0.2.pdf, SOC2_cert_snippet.pdf, calendar_availability.ics
